import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_VERTEX = 5007;
    static final long BIG = 1000000000L;
    static final long MOD_VAL = 1000000007L;

    static class NetworkEdge {
        int begin;
        int finish;
        long limit;
        long price;
        long used;

        NetworkEdge(int b, int f, long lim, long prc) {
            begin = b;
            finish = f;
            limit = lim;
            price = prc;
            used = 0;
        }
    }

    static List<NetworkEdge> all_edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static long[] distance = new long[MAX_VERTEX];
    static long[] potential = new long[MAX_VERTEX];
    static List<Integer>[] graph = new List[MAX_VERTEX];
    static int[] previous_edge_index = new int[MAX_VERTEX];

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VERTEX; i++) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int[] demand = new int[n];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            demand[--x]++;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            link(5000, i, demand[i], 0);
        }

        for (int iter = 0; iter < m; iter++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int layer = 0; layer < 99; layer++) {
                long cost = d;
                for (int rep = 0; rep < 50; rep++) {
                    link(u + layer * 50, v + (layer + 1) * 50, 1, cost);
                    link(v + layer * 50, u + (layer + 1) * 50, 1, cost);
                    cost += 2 * d;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int layer = 0; layer <= 99; layer++) {
            link(layer * 50, 5001, Long.MAX_VALUE, c * layer);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int layer = 0; layer < 99; layer++) {
                link(i + layer * 50, i + (layer + 1) * 50, Long.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            }
        }

        long[] result = solve_flow(5000, 5001);
        pw.println(result[0]);
        pw.close();
    }

    static void link(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        graph[u].add(all_edges.size());
        all_edges.add(new NetworkEdge(u, v, cap, cost));
        graph[v].add(all_edges.size());
        all_edges.add(new NetworkEdge(v, u, 0, -cost));
    }

    static void relax(int src, int cnt) {
        Arrays.fill(potential, BIG);
        potential[src] = 0;
        for (int round = 0; round < cnt; round++) {
            for (int idx = 0; idx < all_edges.size(); idx++) {
                NetworkEdge e = all_edges.get(idx);
                if (e.limit == e.used) continue;
                if (potential[e.begin] == BIG) continue;
                if (potential[e.begin] + e.price < potential[e.finish]) {
                    potential[e.finish] = potential[e.begin] + e.price;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void shortest_path(int source) {
        Arrays.fill(distance, BIG);
        distance[source] = 0;
        PriorityQueue<Node> heap = new PriorityQueue<>();
        heap.offer(new Node(0, source));
        while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
            Node node = heap.poll();
            long d_val = node.dist;
            int u = node.vertex;
            if (d_val != distance[u]) continue;
            for (int id : graph[u]) {
                NetworkEdge e = all_edges.get(id);
                if (e.limit == e.used) continue;
                int v = e.finish;
                long w = e.price + potential[u] - potential[v];
                if (distance[u] + w < distance[v]) {
                    distance[v] = distance[u] + w;
                    previous_edge_index[v] = id;
                    heap.offer(new Node(distance[v], v));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long[] solve_flow(int s, int t) {
        relax(s, 50);
        shortest_path(s);
        long flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (distance[t] != BIG) {
            long augment = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            long path_cost = 0;
            for (int cur = t; cur != s; ) {
                int id = previous_edge_index[cur];
                augment = Math.min(augment, all_edges.get(id).limit - all_edges.get(id).used);
                path_cost += all_edges.get(id).price;
                cur = all_edges.get(id).begin;
            }
            flow += augment;
            cost += augment * path_cost;
            for (int cur = t; cur != s; ) {
                int id = previous_edge_index[cur];
                all_edges.get(id).used += augment;
                all_edges.get(id ^ 1).used -= augment;
                cur = all_edges.get(id).begin;
            }
            shortest_path(s);
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VERTEX; i++) {
                potential[i] = distance[i];
            }
        }
        return new long[]{cost, flow};
    }

    static class Node implements Comparable<Node> {
        long dist;
        int vertex;

        Node(long dist, int vertex) {
            this.dist = dist;
            this.vertex = vertex;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Node other) {
            return Long.compare(this.dist, other.dist);
        }
    }
}
